contexts.bottom_group: SEQUENCER - timing, pattern, and motion shape

bottom_slots.label: RATE
bottom_slots.tooltip: Clock ratio for this lane relative to the master tempo.

bottom_slots.label: PHASE
bottom_slots.tooltip: Moves this lane around the shared clock without changing its rate.

bottom_slots.label: SHAPE
bottom_slots.tooltip: Motion shape generated on accepted steps.

bottom_slots.label: HITS
bottom_slots.tooltip: Number of active steps in the lane's 16-step Euclidean pattern.

bottom_slots.label: ROTATE
bottom_slots.tooltip: Rotates the 16-step pattern while keeping the hit count.

bottom_slots.label: CHANCE
bottom_slots.tooltip: Probability that an active pattern step is accepted.

bottom_slots.label: REPEAT
bottom_slots.tooltip: Repeats the lane's deterministic random address cycle; Free never wraps it.

bottom_slots.label: DEPTH
bottom_slots.tooltip: Overall amount of lane motion; zero also prevents new triggers.

contexts.guide: VOICE edits the base sound. The lower SEQUENCER row decides when and how the lane moves.

top_slots.label: MODEL
top_slots.tooltip: Base synthesis model for this lane. Model Sweep moves from this model.

top_slots.label: PITCH
top_slots.tooltip: Base MIDI note before lane Pitch motion is applied.

top_slots.label: HARMONICS
top_slots.tooltip: Primary harmonic structure control for the selected model.

top_slots.label: TIMBRE
top_slots.tooltip: First model-dependent tone or texture control.

top_slots.label: MORPH
top_slots.tooltip: Second model-dependent tone or texture control.

top_slots.label: DECAY
top_slots.tooltip: Controls the internal low-pass-gate decay time.

top_slots.label: COLOUR
top_slots.tooltip: Controls the low-pass-gate response and brightness.

top_slots.label: LEVEL
top_slots.tooltip: Final level of this voice before the shared cohesion body.

bottom_slots.label: RATE

bottom_slots.label: PHASE

bottom_slots.label: SHAPE

bottom_slots.label: HITS

bottom_slots.label: ROTATE

bottom_slots.label: CHANCE

contexts.guide: MOTION sets where the lane shape is sent. Direct means no movement; Trigger is simply Off or On.

top_slots.label: TRIGGER
top_slots.tooltip: Click the knob to toggle new notes from accepted steps. Off is intentionally silent; On has no negative depth.

top_slots.label: PITCH
top_slots.tooltip: Signed amount by which lane motion bends the base Pitch.

top_slots.label: MODEL SWEEP
top_slots.tooltip: Signed amount by which lane motion walks through models from the base Model.

top_slots.label: HARMONICS
top_slots.tooltip: Signed lane motion sent to Harmonics.

top_slots.label: TIMBRE
top_slots.tooltip: Signed lane motion sent to Timbre.

top_slots.label: MORPH
top_slots.tooltip: Signed lane motion sent to Morph.

top_slots.label: DECAY
top_slots.tooltip: Signed lane motion sent to Decay.

top_slots.label: LEVEL
top_slots.tooltip: Signed lane motion sent to voice Level.

bottom_slots.label: BPM
bottom_slots.tooltip: Master tempo shared by all seven lane rates.

bottom_slots.label: MASTER
bottom_slots.tooltip: Final stereo output gain.

contexts.guide: COHERE brings all seven voices into one body. Set it to zero for the exact dry mix; Clear removes only the body's history.

top_slots.label: DRIVE
top_slots.tooltip: Pressure into the shared body; it cannot leak when Cohere is zero.

top_slots.label: COHERE
top_slots.tooltip: Crossfades the exact dry seven-voice mix into the shared resonant body.

top_slots.label: ROOT
top_slots.tooltip: Root MIDI note used to tune the shared body.

top_slots.label: SPREAD
top_slots.tooltip: Moves the body's six modes from harmonic toward inharmonic spacing.

top_slots.label: TAIL
top_slots.tooltip: Length of the shared resonant decay.

top_slots.label: DAMP
top_slots.tooltip: Darkens and shortens high resonant modes.

top_slots.label: WIDTH
top_slots.tooltip: Stereo spread of the shared body.

top_slots.label: DUCK
top_slots.tooltip: Makes space in the body for new dry attacks.
